kind: deterministic accounting and content-correctness experiment; not UI or heap benchmark

assumptions.cacheEstimate: UTF-16 text payload plus two 256-slot reference arrays per retained chunk
excludedFromEstimate: old snapshots and incoming read buffers
layout, rendering, native and repository caches
assumptions.source: deterministic generated Hebrew with niqqud, Latin, blank lines, headings and inline-note markup
assumptions.budgetScope: one simulated coordinator; current Otzaria windows share one engine/isolate, so a shared text-cache coordinator is feasible; this is not a process RSS cap
assumptions.fullWarmupComparison: potential after full warming of N independently active unsplit readers; current split panes already disable warming
assumptions.trace: 23 moves: forward, reverse, four far jumps; both 96-line and 768-line requested steps are tested, with shorter steps for the 2000-line book
assumptions.prefetch: same maximum of four extra chunks: symmetric 2+2 or directional 3 ahead +1 behind
assumptions.admission: all visible chunks pinned; remaining estimated capacity shared equally; first unknown candidate can be read and rejected; previously observed sizes prevent an identical read when it still cannot fit

observedSizeCache.eviction: oldest read, refreshed only by an actual source read
observedSizeCache.sourceRevision: immutable generated source; production would need invalidation when source content changes

assumptions.pinnedGranularity: whole fetched 256-line chunks intersecting a contiguous viewport; this can retain more payload than the actual visible lines
assumptions.pinStress: 200 source lines (the current continuous-paragraph line cap) containing one synthetic oversized source line; a line-count cap does not bound UTF-16 payload
assumptions.selectionPins: not modeled: selection, notes, and plugin request pins may be disjoint; retainRange only models a contiguous interval
productionIntegrationBlockers: plugin_bridge_adapter._loadPluginTextSection reads open-reader state.content without checking loadedLineFlags
buildPageShapeNotesColumn derives inline note rows/ordinals from currently retained content
cross-line selection and note creation need source-range pinning or explicit repository reads
